newsitem.title: USA: Harley-Davidson European market share off.
newsitem.headline: Harley-Davidson European market share off.

text.p: Harley-Davidson Inc said its share of the European market for motorcycles with engines of 651 cubic centimers (CC) or larger declined to 5.8 percent from 6.5 percent a year ago.
The European 651-plus cc market grew at a 5.3 percent rate year-to-date.

"We now realize that the near-term growth in Europe for Harley-Davidson motorcycles will be slower than we originally thought," company president Jeff Bleustein said in a statement. "...Through our close relationships with our distributors, dealers and customers, we have learned that in addition to continuing to upgrade our infrastructure, we will need to adapt our products more specifically to European markets."
He said some initiatives will take longer than others, but said the company remains confident that Europe offers long-term growth opportunities for Harley.
Earlier, Harley said its share of the 651-plus cc market in the U.S. was 46.6 percent, up from 44.7 percent a year ago.
